notes: MemecoinCemetery is the sole application contract, intended for Ethereum mainnet, with no constructor arguments or initialization calls. Anyone may open a 30-day wake for an ERC-20 with an epitaph of at most 140 bytes. During the wake, a holder of at least 0.1% of the current nonzero total supply may cancel burial, starting a 30-day re-dig cooldown. After an unopposed wake ends, anyone may seal a permanent grave. Token supply and balance reads use try/catch; failed reads reject digging or objections. The contract has no application token, fees, owner, upgrade mechanism or payable entry points and requires no ETH funding.
